body: I did some more digging, and from what I know and see on the net, since the embedded game has the editor as its owner, their message queues are connected. As a result, when the game window becomes unresponsive, the parent window also freezes. I'm not an expert on Windows message queues and threading, so maybe someone else can help find a solution. On my end, I really don't know how to prevent this behavior. To my knowledge, the same thing happens in Unity or Unreal.
Thanks, very interesting!! Keep up the good work!!
